translation:
When the disease is in the exterior, then the interstices are depressed, the yang qi is closed and sealed, and cannot disperse and escape, hence there is dryness without sweat, and the qi and fluids cannot exit. The later generations do not know this, hence seeing the frequent urination of wasting-thirst, they recklessly say it is cold of the lower part. How would they know that the dryness-heat of the intestines and stomach being depressed is what causes it? This is why I raise this.

The world says that the pattern of wasting-thirst is that outside the intestines and stomach there is dryness-heat, which obstructs and closes the pathways of seepage and drainage; although water enters within the intestines and stomach, it cannot seep and drain to the exterior, hence the urine is frequent and yet thirst recurs.
